records.text: And you held up my book, Israel and Civilization, Ollie (interviewer; surname unverified). The last words I think Charlie (Charlie Kirk) spoke to me were— he literally said, 'You know, Josh, you know, when the Israel question comes up, I'm just going to plug your book, you know, Israel and Civilization, because I think that what you write in the book basically is how I feel as well.'" And that ends up being the last time that we spoke.
records.speaker: Josh Hammer
